nodes.description: Constant mint price of 0.05 ETH per NFT used in mint() payment validation.
Constant maximum number of tokens mintable in a single mint() transaction.
Mutable total token supply cap, changeable by owner via setMaxTokenSupply.
Boolean toggle controlling whether minting is enabled.
Pseudo-random starting index derived from a stored block hash for token shuffling.
Block number captured for later blockhash-based starting index computation.
Base URI prefix used for token metadata resolution.
Mapping of tokenId to individual token URI override.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive to enable or disable minting.
Owner-only function transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that mints a number of reserved tokens to msg.sender and captures startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only function updating the MAX_SUPPLY state variable.
Payable public mint function validating sale state, supply, purchase limit and exact ETH payment before minting.
Owner-only function computing startingIndex from a stored blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
Owner-only fallback that records the current block number as startingIndexBlock.
Internal override returning the stored base URI extension.
Owner-only function updating the base URI used for metadata.
Returns the metadata URI for a token, combining base URI and per-token URI.
Internal ERC721 safe mint that mints the token and invokes the receiver callback check.
Private ERC721 function that performs an external call to the recipient contract's onERC721Received.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and withdraw destination.
Native ETH transfer to msg.sender inside withdraw, an external value call.
SafeMath add/mul arithmetic computing total supply and required payment in mint.
blockhash-derived modulo computation producing predictable startingIndex.
External callback into the token recipient contract via onERC721Received.
Parameter num of reserveTokens specifying how many tokens the owner reserves.
Parameter maxSupply of setMaxTokenSupply used to update the supply cap.
Parameter numberOfTokensMax5 of mint controlling how many tokens are purchased.
Parameter baseURI_ of setBaseURI holding the new base URI string.
Parameter tokenId of tokenURI identifying the token whose metadata is queried.
Local variable in withdraw holding the contract ETH balance.
Local variable in reserveTokens holding the current total supply.
Loop counter i in reserveTokens.
Loop counter i in mint.
Local variable in tokenURI holding the per-token URI override.
Local variable in tokenURI holding the base URI value.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the destination of the full balance transfer in withdraw, so the caller controls the payout address.
reserveTokens mints reserved tokens directly to msg.sender.
mint uses msg.sender as the recipient of purchased tokens.
withdraw executes an external value transfer to msg.sender before completing.
mint computes totalSupply().add(numberOfTokensMax5) and NFT_PRICE.mul(numberOfTokensMax5) for payment validation.
calcStartingIndex derives startingIndex via blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY arithmetic.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call to the recipient contract's onERC721Received callback.
mint calls _safeMint in a loop, which can hand control to a malicious receiver contract before mint completes.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint in a loop to mint reserved tokens.
The receiver callback can re-enter mint before state finalization.
setMaxTokenSupply writes the MAX_SUPPLY state variable under onlyOwner.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable under onlyOwner.
setBaseURI writes _baseURIExtended under onlyOwner.
tokenURI reads _baseURIExtended for metadata construction.
tokenURI reads the _tokenURIs mapping for the requested token.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock under onlyOwner.
calcStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable.
reserveTokens conditionally sets startingIndexBlock from block.number.
mint reads MAX_SUPPLY to enforce the supply cap.
mint reads NFT_PRICE and multiplies it by the requested token count to compare with msg.value.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true before allowing purchases.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base URI.
The num parameter bounds the reserveTokens minting loop.
The maxSupply parameter is assigned to the MAX_SUPPLY state variable.
The numberOfTokensMax5 parameter drives supply and payment arithmetic and the mint loop in mint.
The baseURI_ parameter is assigned to _baseURIExtended.
The tokenId parameter selects which token metadata tokenURI resolves.
The local balance variable feeds the ETH transfer amount in withdraw.
The local supply variable supplies the starting token id in reserveTokens.
The local loop counter i drives the reserveTokens minting loop.
The local loop counter i drives the minting loop in mint.
The local _tokenURI variable holds the per-token URI used by tokenURI.
The local base variable holds the base URI used by tokenURI.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter only exists to bound the reserveTokens minting loop and has no independent semantic identity.
The maxSupply parameter is directly assigned to MAX_SUPPLY and never used elsewhere.
The numberOfTokensMax5 parameter is only consumed by mint's validation checks and minting loop.
The baseURI_ parameter is immediately written into _baseURIExtended by setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is only used to index token data inside tokenURI.
The local balance variable is a temporary holder for the transfer amount inside withdraw.
The local supply variable is a transient snapshot of totalSupply used only by reserveTokens.
The loop counter i is scoped entirely to the reserveTokens minting loop.
The loop counter i is scoped entirely to the mint minting loop.
The local _tokenURI variable is a transient read of the _tokenURIs mapping used only inside tokenURI.
The local base variable is a transient read of _baseURI used only inside tokenURI.
